messages:
zoe: nightly-eval alert: early-termination spike on stop-seq tests for rdx-2.1-int8-canary. 3.2x baseline on our 'stop at ###' promptset

eval-bot: ALERT 2245678901: early_stop_rate=0.213 (baseline=0.066) failing_prompts=42/200

maya: yikes. which test cases most affected?

eli: looks like prompts that rely on multi-token stop sequences ("### END" and "\n\n") are truncating mid-sequence

sam: any config changes yesterday? tokenizer/decoder/quant?

maya: we merged tokenizer v1.14 that changed merge rules for trailing spaces + packedkv quant pack update landed in serving yesterday

eli: quick triage: service logs show stop-sequence matched after partial tokenization in the decoder step, so generation returned early before the full stop sequence tokens emitted

zoe: repro on my laptop with rdx-2.1-int8-canary + tokenizer v1.14: run below

```bash
python tools/generate.py --model rdx-2.1-int8-canary --prompt 'User: list items
### END' --stop_sequences '### END' --max_tokens 200
```

maya: confirmed. running same command with tokenizer v1.13 yields no early stops

sam: root cause hypothesis: tokenizer v1.14 changed BPE merges for trailing spaces so multi-token stop sequences are tokenized differently; combined with the int8-packed kernel's decode tie-breaking the runtime considers a partial token boundary as a stop

eli: agree. reproduced locally by diffing token ids for the stop sequence across tokenizer versions

maya: mitigation plan (short):
- rollback canary to rdx-2.1-int8-stable (done)
- hotfix decoder: only trigger stop when full token sequence matched at token boundaries (PR #3456 opened)
- add gating rule: early_stop_rate delta > 0.05 relative to baseline blocks promotion
- add targeted eval: stop-seq sensitivity tests to nightly suite and a short canary run pre-promotion
- re-run full nightly with hotfix before re-promoting

sam: ownership: maya -> rollback + canary config, eli -> decoder PR + unit tests, zoe -> add eval tests + alerting rule, sam -> postmortem and customer comms

zoe: timeline?
maya: rollback finished at 2245678920, hotfix PR submitted and CI started

eval-bot: queued nightly re-run against rdx-2.1-int8-hotfix (job 8892)

eli: follow-ups (post-hotfix): add unit tests to assert tokenizer->stop-token mapping parity, instrument canary dashboard (stop_rate by prompt-group), add pre-promotion smoke that runs stop-seq promptset end-to-end

zoe: blockers?
maya: none right now, CI running. will post results here when re-run completes

sam: thanks team. good catch. add note to model-onboarding checklist: verify stop-sequence parity across tokenizer and quant builds

ops-bot: rollback to rdx-2.1-int8-stable applied at 2245678928 :white_check_mark:

zoe: closing loop when nightly passes. :raised_hands:
